dev-setup-bundle.description: Apply Aquarium development-tool setup across multiple Git repositories from one external YAML manifest. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:dev-setup-bundle with a manifest path; single-repository setup belongs to /aquarium:dev-setup.

dev-setup.description: Diagnose and configure Aquarium repository tooling, paired skills, MCP registrations, and the evidence-based AGENTS.md operating contract. Use when the user invokes /aquarium:dev-setup or asks to install, initialize, repair, or audit supported tools; routine Procedure v2 session lifecycle belongs to /use-podway.

docs-setup.description: Audit, establish, adopt, or migrate a repository's canonical documentation structure and roadmap IDs. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:docs-setup; do not use for routine task documentation.

epic-handler.description: Deliver or resume one named roadmap epic through sequential task goals, evidence-gated commits, and epic-wide remediation. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:epic-handler with a roadmap path and exactly one epic ID; never invoke it implicitly.

epic-validator.description: Cold-validate one completed roadmap epic through a bounded audit and one remediation-and-confirmation cycle. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:epic-validator with a roadmap path and exactly one completed epic ID; never invoke it implicitly.

independent-review.description: Run one supervised static review with fresh reviewer subagents against staged changes, a commit or range, one task or epic, or an investigation. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:independent-review and asks for an independent verdict without remediation.

new-feature.description: Shape one feature epic for an existing project with Ouroboros, without implementing it. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:new-feature.

new-project.description: Shape a greenfield project into an approved PRD and initial roadmap with Ouroboros, without implementing it. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:new-project.

orca-review.description: Run the canonical independent-review contract through a user-selected Claude Fable, Kimi, Agy, or Cursor Agent in Orca. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:orca-review and asks for an external-provider review.

refactor.description: Shape one major refactor or behavior-change epic with Ouroboros, without implementing it. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:refactor.

release-handler.description: Prepare, validate, publish, or retarget one stable release with cumulative changelog settlement. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:release-handler for one intended or planned version.

release-qa.description: Run one full scenario-based QA pass for an exact main release candidate, or one bounded confirmation pass after remediation. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:release-qa or /aquarium:release-handler delegates one intended version.

task-close.description: Confirm and close one reviewed roadmap task with an explicitly selected terminal status. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates closeout or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-close with exact task identity and complete review evidence.

task-commit.description: Prepare and create one authorized Git commit while reconciling roadmap task lifecycle state and preserving unrelated work. Use when the user asks to commit in a repository that may contain a roadmap, an Aquarium handler hands off an approved commit, or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-commit.

task-document.description: Update durable documentation and review status for one refined roadmap task. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates documentation or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-document to resume that phase.

task-handler.description: Strengthen or resume the procedure around one named roadmap task goal through planning, implementation, verification, refinement, documentation, review, and closeout. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-handler with a roadmap path and exactly one task ID; never invoke it implicitly.

task-implement.description: Implement the approved plan for one named roadmap task. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates implementation or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-implement to resume that phase.

task-plan.description: Plan one named roadmap task without mutation. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates planning or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-plan to resume that phase with one task ID.

task-refine.description: Deslop and optimize the implementation-checked diff for one roadmap task before final verification. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates refinement or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-refine for that phase.

task-review.description: Run and resolve Mulgae review for one complete roadmap task diff. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates review or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-review with exact task identity.

task-verify.description: Strengthen and verify evidence for one implemented roadmap task. Use when /aquarium:task-handler delegates verification or the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:task-verify to resume that phase.

test-setup.description: Audit and configure the common Make or Bun testing contract for one repository, with evidence-backed legacy waivers. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:test-setup for test infrastructure or TESTING.md setup.

war-room.description: Diagnose one difficult bug and shape the next work unit with Ouroboros, without implementing a fix. Use when the user explicitly invokes /aquarium:war-room.
